notes.title: Paul's World is ready!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

The big day is soon and we are ready for it!
Paul's World will be live on November 18 and we have a 40% launch discount, valid for the first week!

So, don’t miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160880/Pauls_World/

Paul's World is an Old-School RPG game. We designed this game for mini rpg & survival fans. Farming, crafting, combat, fishing, mini games and more, just explore it! Monsters, wild animals, aliens... Who do you think will win? 

As always, thank you for your love and support.

Cheers, Cloaz Studio!
